subject: [hw] T01 fuzz -> V18: line 313 has the same shift-by-64 (s == 0)
body: Follow-up: with recoverable UBSan the first 200k+200k trials also report `n2a32_neon_3same.c:313:13: shift exponent 64`. Same esize==64 saturating path, `v >> (64 - s)` with s == 0 (v>>64). Please cover both 313 and 329 with an `if (s == 0)` fast path; no other UBSan site appeared in 400k trials (ASan clean, only UNDEF/FAULT/LIMIT/RETURN stops). Will re-run the full 2M once you post the fix.
